why: The opacity ladder (design/w1b-opaque-statements.md), rule unary-coercion: unary + on an object (ToNumber of an object, NaN here). The construct can make a value outside the model, and the translator reads its unit whole (the numeric boundary): the unit is one opaque function keyed by its source and the same-file units it reaches, and every same-file caller is one too, so no exact reading meets the value. unchanged: one key on both sides, proved. escapes: a reordered return changes the source, another symbol, not proved (lane B: the same behaviour, PASS-bounded). caller: it reaches escapes, so it is opaque too and its own reordering is not proved; its record lists no site of its own.
